us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Georgia school shooter sentenced to life without parole
bullets: Colt Gray, 16, was sentenced in Barrow County Superior Court.
He was convicted of killing two students and two teachers at Apalachee High School.
The sentencing hearing took place Tuesday in Winder, Georgia.

articles.title: Court panel leaves Trump mail-ballot order in place for now
bullets: A federal court panel declined to block the executive order immediately.
The ruling leaves uncertainty over how the order may affect the 2026 midterms.
Protests over proposed postal and mail-ballot changes were held in several cities.

articles.title: Kentucky governor urges McConnell to prove fitness or resign
bullets: Gov. Andy Beshear called on Sen. Mitch McConnell to demonstrate capacity to serve.
Beshear also asked Senate Majority Leader John Thune to review the matter.
McConnell’s office has faced renewed questions over the senator’s health and duties.

articles.title: US consumer confidence falls as gas prices rise
bullets: The Conference Board’s consumer confidence index fell to 90.8 in July.
AP reported the national average gasoline price rose to $4.10 a gallon Tuesday.
The survey showed continued concern about inflation, food costs and jobs.

articles.title: New York school pauses AI robot-teacher plan after backlash
bullets: A New York school paused plans to deploy a humanlike AI robot teacher.
The proposal drew criticism from parents and educators.
The case adds to scrutiny over AI use in classrooms.

articles.title: Iran resumes missile attacks as US and Saudi forces strike Iraqi militias
bullets: Iran resumed missile attacks after a short pause in fighting.
US and Saudi forces struck Tehran-backed militia sites in Iraq.
The escalation followed renewed Middle East violence tied to the Iran war.

articles.title: France battles massive wildfire as heat threatens containment
bullets: A wildfire in southwest France burned an area reported at four times the size of Paris.
Authorities kept evacuation orders in place as temperatures were forecast near 40 C.
Spain also faced major wildfire evacuations during another heat wave.

articles.title: Japan quake leaves dozens missing after shopping-center collapse
bullets: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake hit southern Kyushu.
AP reported injuries and missing people after a shopping center collapse.
Authorities assessed damage and tsunami-related risks after the quake.

articles.title: DR Congo Ebola cases pass 3,200 and approach record
bullets: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 3,200 cases.
AP reported the total is nearing the country’s record level.
Health authorities continued outbreak response and containment work.

articles.title: China landslide death toll rises to 41
bullets: A landslide in southwest China killed at least 41 people.
Authorities continued rescue and recovery operations in the affected area.
The disaster followed heavy rain and unstable ground conditions.

articles.title: Supreme Court bars coercive action against student protesters
bullets: The Supreme Court directed relief for minors and some student protesters.
The case follows the July 20 protest crackdown linked to exam-leak demonstrations.
The court also discussed scrutiny of police conduct during the protests.

articles.title: Public examinations reform bill on Parliament agenda
bullets: The Lok Sabha listed the Public Examinations amendment bill for consideration.
The bill comes amid continuing anger over paper leaks and entrance-exam irregularities.
Student protests have kept pressure on the education ministry.

articles.title: Heavy rains and flooding disrupt parts of eastern and northeastern India
bullets: Odisha recorded heavy rainfall as a deep depression affected the region.
Assam flood survivors reported major damage and displacement.
Delhi and nearby areas also faced rain alerts and waterlogging.

articles.title: Assam factory blast kills four; owner among five arrested
bullets: An Assam metal factory explosion killed four workers.
Police arrested five people, including the owner, after the incident.
Investigators said molten metal may have burst out during work inside the unit.

articles.title: India to keep engaging with US after new tariff measures
bullets: India said it would continue pursuing a bilateral trade agreement with the US.
Washington imposed a 10% duty on imports from India under new measures.
India said some key products were excluded, including generic drugs and smartphones.

articles.title: Generac jumps premarket after profit beat
bullets: AP reported Generac shares rose 4.3% in premarket trading.
The backup-power company beat Wall Street profit expectations.
Generac said it is increasing production to clear data-center generator backlogs.

articles.title: Procter & Gamble slides after flat organic sales
bullets: AP reported P&G shares fell more than 3% after results.
The company said fourth-quarter organic sales were flat.
Analysts had expected organic sales growth of about 2%.

articles.title: Ford gains after raising profit outlook
bullets: Premarket chatter highlighted Ford shares rising after a stronger outlook.
Investors focused on the company’s updated profit guidance.
Ford was among large US names moving around earnings news.
articles.source: Reddit market thread / market news aggregation

articles.title: Microsoft trades higher ahead of earnings
bullets: Microsoft was scheduled to report quarterly results after the close.
The stock was higher in early trading on Wednesday.
Investors were watching cloud and AI spending commentary.

articles.title: Starbucks in focus before after-hours results
bullets: Starbucks was listed among major companies reporting after Wednesday’s close.
The stock was slightly lower in early trading.
Investors watched for sales trends and margin guidance.

articles.title: eBay agrees to pay nearly $50 million in harassment case
bullets: eBay agreed to pay nearly $50 million to a couple targeted by former employees.
The harassment included disturbing deliveries such as cockroaches and a bloody pig mask.
The case stemmed from retaliation against online critics of the company.

articles.title: Fed expected to hold rates despite high prices
bullets: The Federal Reserve decision was due Wednesday.
Markets widely expected no rate change at this meeting.
AP reported traders were watching for signs of a possible September hike.

articles.title: Oil jumps as Middle East violence flares again
bullets: Brent crude rose by more than $3 a barrel in Wednesday trading.
US benchmark crude also climbed after renewed missile attacks.
Energy markets reacted to threats around the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Trump tariff measures keep pressure on trade partners
bullets: The administration’s latest tariff measures remained a major business story.
India said it would keep engaging Washington on a bilateral trade deal.
Companies continued assessing the impact on supply chains and import costs.

articles.title: Companies reassess AI costs as token-heavy use fades
bullets: Workplaces are looking for cheaper ways to run AI tools.
The trend follows corporate scrutiny of high token usage and model costs.
AP framed the shift as a limit to the ‘tokenmaxxing’ fad.

articles.title: Instagram and YouTube found liable in social-media addiction trial
bullets: A New Mexico jury found the platforms liable in a landmark case.
The jury imposed a $375 million penalty.
The verdict focused on alleged harms to children’s mental health.

articles.title: AI robot teacher plan paused after backlash in New York
bullets: A New York school paused a planned humanoid AI teacher deployment.
The proposal drew backlash from the school community.
The story highlights growing debate over AI’s role in education.

articles.title: Corporate AI users look beyond high-token workflows
bullets: AP reported companies are seeking cheaper AI approaches.
The shift comes as heavy token usage raises operating costs.
OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI providers are part of the broader enterprise-cost debate.

articles.title: Microsoft earnings put cloud and AI spending in focus
bullets: Microsoft was scheduled to report fiscal fourth-quarter results after the close.
Investors were watching Azure, AI demand and capital-spending signals.
The report was one of the week’s biggest tech market events.

articles.title: Meta earnings expected after social-platform verdict week
bullets: Meta was scheduled to report quarterly results after Wednesday’s close.
The company also faced attention after the Instagram liability verdict.
Investors were watching advertising, AI spending and user-growth trends.
